title: Mission 6 — Helping a neighbour
summary: Your new neighbour Līga in Daugavpils asks for help carrying groceries. Make small talk, accept an invitation for tea, and politely decline a second helping.
summary_lv: Tava jaunā kaimiņiene Līga Daugavpilī lūdz palīdzēt aiznest produktus. Iesaisties sarunā, pieņem ielūgumu uz tēju un pieklājīgi atsakies no otras porcijas.

scenes.title: Offer help
scenes.instruction: Offer to help Līga carry her grocery bags up to the apartment.
scenes.instruction_lv: Piedāvā Līgai palīdzēt aiznest somas uz dzīvokli.

scenes.title: Accept tea politely
scenes.instruction: Thank Līga and accept her invitation for a cup of tea.
scenes.instruction_lv: Pateicies Līgai un pieņem ielūgumu uz tēju.

scenes.title: Decline a second helping politely
scenes.instruction: Tell Līga the food was delicious but you are full and have to go.
scenes.instruction_lv: Pasaki Līgai, ka bija garšīgi, bet tu esi paēdis un tev jāiet.
